task.title: To make a clause and bundle smart in a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work > Clauses.
The Clauses pane lists all the clauses present in your template. Select a clause from the list and click the Settings icon () adjacent to the clause name .

ol.li: For a clause, toggle the Smart Clause switch on and click Save.
For a bundle, toggle the Smart Bundle switch on and click Save.

postreq.p: Your template clause and clause bundle now have smartness property. To remove the smartness property of a clause or clause bundle, toggle the Smart Clause or Smart Bundle switch off (greyed out).
